title: SOC2 evidence daily scratchpad
content:
Daily scratchpad: SOC2 evidence + vendor review quick notes

03/03/2026 — morning run-through
- Quick status: picking up where I left off last week. Need to finalize S3 access evidence and confirm rotation timestamps for service accounts.
- Today focus: vendor evidence (Datadog, Auth0), finalize access review spreadsheet, follow up with infra on backup retention log.

TO-DO (priority order)
1) S3 bucket access proof for logs (owner: Carmen) — TODO: get signed screenshot from infra console or CloudTrail query. Query path: aws-account-123 / redwood-logs / access-history. Target: 2026-03-06. Linked to CONFLUENCE-SEC-1287.
2) Service account key rotation evidence (owner: Liam) — Confirm rotation timestamps for batch-worker-sa, inference-ingest-sa. Ask infra for CSV export or KMS logs. Slack ping sent to @liam 03/03.
3) Datadog vendor review (owner: Carmen + Priya) — needs contract excerpt showing SOC2 coverage + recent penetration test summary. Action: Priya to pull contract PDF, Carmen to summarize scope.
4) Auth0 (SSO) evidence (owner: Maya) — need SSO configuration export and list of second factors enforced. Maya to export tenant settings and MFA policy screenshot.
5) Backup retention logs (owner: infra) — missing entries from 2026-02-20 to 2026-02-25. File ticket JIRA-SEC-452. Follow-up: check tape / cold storage logs.
6) Vendor subprocessor list update — vendors.csv stale. Quick scan: Datadog, Auth0, Sentry, Segment, Stripe. Confirm current PII access for each.
7) Policy TODOs: update "Access Provisioning" doc — add emergency access workflow and approval steps. Draft new section and link to runbook.

Notes / evidence snippets:
- Access review spreadsheet: columns = user, role, last_active, owner, evidence_link. Current status: 120 entries, 10 flagged (inactive >90d). Need owners to confirm or deprovision.
- Suggested ask for infra: "Can you export CloudTrail events for s3:PutObject/GetObject for redwood-logs from 2026-02-01 to 2026-03-01 and include IAM principal and requestParameters.bucketName?"
- For Auth0: MFA enforcement is "optional for legacy orgs" per tenant settings — escalate to product-security for blanket enforcement.

Open questions / blocks:
- How to present evidence for continuous batching service? There are ephemeral keys used by the runtime; we need a mapping doc from runtime->service-account->rotation policy. Infra says mapping exists but not centralized.
- Vendor contracts: some are stored in Zendesk attachments (old vendor onboarding), ask Legal to provide canonical copies.

Meeting notes (quick): 03/04 sync with Priya + Maya
- Priya: will upload Datadog contract + pentest summary by EOD 03/05.
- Maya: Auth0 configs exported, will annotate what screenshots map to SOC2 criteria.
- Liam: promised CSV of service account rotations by 03/05; still pending.
- Action: set reminder to follow up 03/06 if missing.

Quick drafts (for later copy into Confluence):
- Evidence index (short):
  * Identity & Access Management: access review spreadsheet link, service account rotation CSV, SSO config export.
  * Logging & Monitoring: CloudTrail export for log buckets, Datadog SOC2 scope.
  * Backup & Recovery: retention policy doc + backup confirmation logs.
  * Vendor Management: vendor.csv + contracts + subprocessors.

Scratch/notes to self:
- When I attach screenshots, include timestamp & viewer principal in filename (e.g., s3-access-screenshot_2026-03-03_carmen.png).
- Keep one canonical evidence folder per control (avoid duplicates).
- Build a short checklist template for owners to fill (yes/no boxes + link to artifact).

Short checklist (to convert to sheet):
- [ ] Evidence artifact uploaded (link)
- [ ] Owner confirmed
- [ ] Timestamped screenshot or log export attached
- [ ] Mapping to control ID added

Next steps (this week):
- 03/05: follow up w/ Liam on rotation CSV.
- 03/05: upload Datadog contract snippets.
- 03/06: finalize S3 evidence and update Confluence index.
- 03/06: send owner reminders for 10 flagged users.

Random ideas / backlog
- Automate periodic export of service account rotations into the evidence bucket (monthly).
- Create simple Lambda that queries CloudTrail for bucket access events and writes a daily digest to evidence bucket.

End of scratchpad.

(Informal notes — will tidy before moving to Confluence)
